# Preserve each QR resource naming contract instead of one case rule

The preference script is qrExport.mjs, paired with qrExport.inc.xhtml. Its privileged data module is QRExport.sys.mjs. Routing uses paneQrExport; CSS hooks and Fluent IDs use qr-panel and qr-export prefixes; menu IDs include appmenu_exportmobile and menu_exportmobile. Manual naming proposal: follow the component family and registered consumers when adding a file, ID or style hook. Do not mechanically turn these separate contracts into one dash-versus-camel rule. Resource registration, template inclusion and module getter references were checked in the accepted tree. Pane DOM IDs such as qrExportIncludePasswords use lowerCamelCase, and label for values match exactly. Unit and browser files use test_qrExport.js and browser_qrExport.js. These names remain separate from the dashed custom widget module/tag and PascalCase widget class.

Scope: mail/qrexport/resource-naming.
